text:
Avery (People Ops): Hey team — quick follow-up from today's all-hands. Drop any promo/leveling/comp/benefits follow-ups here. We'll summarize and post updated timelines tomorrow.

Priya (SWE): If someone is on unpaid sabbatical during calibration, can they still be nominated?

Avery (People Ops): Good callout. Unpaid sabbatical requires manager note in the packet explaining context. We won't penalize for sabbatical, but nominations should include recent evidence of impact (last 6 months) so calibrators have material to review.

Noah (Manager): For leveling rubrics, are we moving to a shorter "signal-first" packet where managers list 3 signals only? Heard it in the meeting but want confirmation.

Diego (Comp): We're piloting a concise packet template: 3 signals (impact metric, cross-team endorsement, ownership example) + one-line comp recommendation. Full write-ups are accepted but the shorter format helps speed calibration.

Remi (Recruiting): How will market adjustments affect hiring offers? If someone internal gets a cash move, do offers also change?

Diego (Comp): Market adjustments influence offer bands; recruiting uses current band midpoints post-refresh. External offer calc is separate but aligned; internal moves don't auto-update offers already accepted.

Priya (SWE): Appeal process? What counts as "material new evidence"?

Avery (People Ops): Material new evidence = verifiable metrics, customer/partner letters, or code-review links not previously considered. Appeals must be submitted within 10 business days and go through the manager. We'll track outcomes and publish anonymized stats.

payroll-bot: Reminder: July payroll cutoff = 2026-06-18. Any confirmed comp changes after cutoff will post in August payroll.

Avery (People Ops): Action items: managers -> use the short packet when possible, attach links, note sabbatical/unavailable reviewers, and flag cross-region comp exceptions. We'll post the short-packet template and cut-off calendar in #announcements tomorrow. Thanks! :heart:
